properties.headline: Fire Weather Watch issued October 15 at 12:18AM PDT until October 16 at 11:00AM PDT by NWS San Francisco CA
properties.description:
...FIRE WEATHER WATCH IN EFFECT FROM THIS EVENING THROUGH FRIDAY
MORNING DUE TO WIND AND LOW RELATIVE HUMIDITY FOR NORTH BAY INTERIOR
MOUNTAINS...

.Moderate offshore winds are expected to develop Thursday night into
Friday morning over the North Bay Interior Mountains. Conditions will
be very dry with very poor overnight humidity recoveries only
reaching 14 to 24 percent. Rapid fire spread is possible given the
combination of gusty northerly winds and very dry overnight
conditions.

The National Weather Service in San Francisco CA has issued a Fire
Weather Watch.

* AFFECTED AREA...North Bay Interior Mountains.

* TIMING...From this evening through Friday morning.

* WINDS 20 FOOT...North winds 5 to 15 mph with gusts up to 30 mph.

* RELATIVE HUMIDITY...Relative Humidity between 14 to 24 percent.

* IMPACTS...Any fires that develop will likely spread rapidly.
Outdoor burning is not recommended.
properties.instruction:
A Fire Weather Watch means that critical fire weather conditions are
forecast during the valid watch time. These conditions could promote
the rapid spread of wildfires which could become life-threatening.
Check weather.gov/mtr for forecast updates and a possible upgrade of
this watch to a Red Flag Warning. Also consider signing up for your
city, county, or state emergency alert system.

Follow all fire restrictions. One less spark, one less wildfire.

Never leave burning debris or camp fires unattended; extinguish them
completely. Avoid using equipment or machinery that could create a
spark. Secure tow chains to avoid dragging and subsequent sparks.
Never toss cigarette butts out of your vehicle's window. Remember,
one less spark, one less flame.

NWSheadline: FIRE WEATHER WATCH IN EFFECT FROM THIS EVENING THROUGH FRIDAY MORNING
